newsitem.title: USA: Novavax to privately place 1,200,000 shrs.
newsitem.headline: Novavax to privately place 1,200,000 shrs.

text.p: Novavax Inc said Monday that it has signed a definitive agreement to privately place 1,200,000 common shares with Anaconda Opportunity Fund L.P., an accredited institutional investor, at a total price of $5,100,000. Novavax will also grant warrants to purchase an additional 600,000 shares at a price of $6 per share and 600,000 shares at a price of $8 a share. The warrants will have a three-year term.
Closing of the financing is contingent upon the effectiveness of a registration statement on Form S-3 registering the shares for resale, to be filed with Securities and Exchange Commission shortly.

Novavax expects that the proceeds from the sale of the shares, net of expenses, will be used to help finance the ongoing human clinical trials of its three lead product candidates, ESTRASORB, ANDROSORB and Helicore.
